image_description: Two men in outdoor fishing gear (red and green jackets) standing on a boat, holding a large sturgeon horizontally between them. The background shows a body of water and distant hills under an overcast sky.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Elongated head with protrusible mouth on ventral surface.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The fish's head is clearly visible; the snout is elongated and the mouth is located on the underside (ventral), consistent with sturgeon anatomy.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Four barbels (sensory whiskers) anterior to mouth.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Four distinct, dangling barbels are visible hanging from the snout area in front of the mouth.
The snout tapers to a distinct point at the anterior end of the fish.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Elongated fusiform body with impressively large, extended proportions.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The fish has a long, torpedo-shaped body that spans the width of the two men holding it, indicating large proportions.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Five rows of bony scutes (plates) along body instead of scales.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Distinct rows of raised, bony plates (scutes) are visible running longitudinally along the lateral line and dorsal ridge, rather than typical fish scales.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Gray, brown, or black dorsally with lighter ventral surface.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The top of the fish is dark gray/brown, transitioning to a white/lighter color on the belly, matching the description.
The tail fin is visible on the left side; the upper lobe is significantly larger and extends further than the lower lobe, characteristic of a heterocercal tail.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the specific species identification and rule out look-alike fish genera.
To verify the structural integrity of the two humans holding the fish, checking for limb fusion or extra digits which are common AI artifacts in group shots.
To ensure the scutes and fins are physically connected to the body without melting or boundary bleeding into the hands holding it.
To verify the spatial relationship between the men, the fish, and the background boat/water.

focus_areas: Human facial symmetry and gear details
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the hands holding the fish. AI often struggles with fingers wrapping around cylindrical objects like fish bodies. Check for 'melting' fingers or missing thumbs. Also, verify the continuity of the scutes; they should not disappear abruptly or blend into the skin texture incorrectly.
